verses.text: In nanak sik'lab'il to malaj b'ak'inh swiloch in k'ol t'a heb' ix kob'estak.
K'inalok swiloch in k'ol t'a heb' ix, ¿tokwal manh ol yak' spak Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ayin?
¿Tom manhok t'a heb' chuk yet' t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och Dios sjawi yahelal?
¿Tokwal max yil Dios tas tzin k'ulej yet' b'ajtak tzin ek'i?
Swak' wal in ti' to malaj mach b'aj chuk swutej in b'a, malaj b'aj ek'nak t'a in k'ol in musan sat anima.
Komonok tzin sch'olb'itej Dios t'a stojolal icha yechtaj yalil junok tas, yik syilani to tz'akan in wach'il.
K'inalok in el t'a b'eyb'al yik tojolal, mato in nib'ejnak in k'ulej tas swilochi, mato ay tas manh wikok in maknak wikok,
tato icha chi', ch'okokab' mach slajankanel sat wawb'en, sjoyokab'k'eta heb' tas awab'il chi' wu'uj.
K'inalok ay junok ix ix, ix kuchb'anb'at in pensar, mato in maklej yelta junok ix yetb'eyum junokxo winak t'a sti' spat,
tato icha chi', ak'jokab' serwil junok ch'ok winakil yuj ix wetb'eyum, wayokab' junok ch'ok winakil yet' ix.
K'inalok in k'ulej juntzanh chi', smoj wal wab'an syahelal tz'ak'jioch t'a wib'anh yuj heb' juez.
Tato icha chi', jaokab' in yahelal. Icha junok niwan k'ak' satanel tastak, ichaokab' ta' tz'aj satanel tastak ay t'ayin.
Ayik stek'b'an sb'a heb' in chekab' yalan t'ayin yuj tas swutej, swab' tas syal heb' chi'.
Tato manh ichaokta ix in k'ulej, ¿tas ol wutej woch t'a yichanh Dios? ¿Tas ol wutej walani ayik ol sk'anb'an t'ayin yuj tas ix in k'ulej?
Junnhej Dios onh ak'an pitzwok t'a ko nun yet' heb' in chekab' chi', hanhejtona' tz'ak'an ko k 'inal.
Manh tonhejok swiloch heb' meb'a' ay stzapan majanil, manh tonhejok swilpaxi to malaj tas swa heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Ayik in wa'i laj wak' yik heb' meb'a' unin wet'ok.
Icha wal wuninal swutej heb' meb'a' unin chi'. In kolwajnhej t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Ayik swilani to ay heb' anima te meb'a' malaj spichul ayochi,
haxo xil nok' in kalnel swak' b'ojok, swak'anoch sk'ixinalok heb'. Yuj chi' syak' yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.
Tato ay b'aj ix wixtej junok meb'a' unin yujto wojtak to chab'il wik yuj heb' yajal,
mak'jokab'el in k'ab' tik, elokab' weknaj in jenhjab' tik.
Yujto tzin xiw yak'an in yahelal Dios, yuj chi' max yal in tek'b'an in b'a t'a yichanh, yujto te niwan yelk'ochi.
Malaj b'aj anhej t'a niwak b'eyumal swak'och in pensar, maj wak'och k'e'en oro yipok in k'o'ol.
Malaj b'aj wik'nakcha'anh in b'a yuj in b'eyumal, ma yuj jantak tas ay t'ayin.
Swil skopopial yok k'u yet' pax yik k'ojan k'e'en uj te wach' yilji,
palta malaj b'aj elk'altak tzin tz'ub'elta in k'ab' yik tzin ch'oxan yechel to tzin tz'ub'elta sti' k'u yet' k'e'en uj chi' yik swak'anem in b'a t'ay.
K'inalok icha chi' swutej in b'a, smoj am wal tz'ak'jioch in yahelal, yujto chab'sat am swutej in b'a t'a Dios ay t'a satcha'anh.
Malaj b'aj in tzalaj yuj yahelal sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' wajk'o'ol, ma yik sjawi chukal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Malaj b'aj ochnak in mul in k'anankot katab' t'a yib'anh heb', yik scham heb'.
Masanil heb' ayek' wet'ok, yojtak wal heb' to ayik sjawi heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'ayin, malaj junok heb' maj ak'ji tas swa'a.
Ha heb' anima sb'eyek'i, maj yal in k'ol skan heb' t'a yoltak calle t'ak'walil, jakannhej in pat t'a heb'.
Malaj in mul syal in k'ub'aneli, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo heb'. Malaj in mul elk'altak yaji,
yujto tzin xiw t'a heb' anima, talaj chuk tas syal heb' t'ayin. Maj in makoch in b'a t'a yol in pat yujto in xiw yuj tas syal heb' in k'ab' wok.

Komonok ay mach tz'ab'an tas swal tik. Ha juntzanh swal tik yelnhej smasanil. Haxo tikne'ik tzin tanhwej tas spak ol ak'jok t'ayin yuj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi'. Ha tas tz'ak'jioch t'a wib'anh chi', komonok wach' yaj stz'ib'chaj yuj winh tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh chi'.
Tato icha chi', tzam wak'k'e b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch chi' t'a sjolom in jenhjab', ma t'a in jolom icha junok corona yik swik'ancha'anh in b'a.
Tzam wal t'a Dios yuj masanil tas ix in k'ulej, max am in k'ixwi in k'och t'a yichanh.
K'inalok tonhej in tok'nakek' lum lum t'a heb' ay yiko', haton lum b'aj tzin munlaji,
k'inalok tonhej ix in wab'at sat tas b'aj ix munlaj heb' in munlajwum, maj in tuppaxlaj heb', a na wan scham heb' yuj wejel.
Tato icha chi', k'ib'okab' te k'i'ix t'a sat in lum chi' sk'exulok ixim trigo, haxo anh komon ank'ultak sk'ib' sk'exulok ixim cebada, xchi winhaj Job chi'. Haton slajwub' slolonel winhaj Job tik.
